overall_goal: Drain the boiled pasta and add it to the sauce

goals.rationale: The person gathers the strainer and the pan of boiled pasta, moves them to the sink, and pours the pasta into the strainer to drain the water.

goals.description: Transfer the drained pasta to the sauce
goals.rationale: The person moves the strainer over the empty pan to catch drips and pours the drained pasta into the pot containing the sauce.
